description: Scott is one of the foremost champions for LGBTQ equality in the country, authoring the nation's first trans state of refuge law and passing landmark protections for LGBTQ youth, LGBTQ seniors, and people living with HIV. As San Francisco’s first gay member of Congress, he will take his fight against Trump's unprecedented assault on LGBTQ people — even at his own personal risk.
